Expedition Base Set

Released September 15, 2002 · 165 cards

Expedition Base Set is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the E-Card series, released in English on September 15, 2002. It has 165 cards. It includes 136 Pokémon, 21 Trainer and 8 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

32 illustrators worked on Expedition Base Set. Most cards: Atsuko Nishida (13), Hajime Kusajima (11), Kagemaru Himeno (11), Kyoko Umemoto (10), Tomokazu Komiya (10), Keiji Kinebuchi (9), Kimiya Masago (8), Mitsuhiro Arita (8).
